description:
Create a Circle — a named group of trusted contacts (the people-primitive powering Proof-Me and Approvals-on-Circle). Optionally seed initial members; each member's declared channels are stored so they can be invited to enroll.

Agent usage: after creating a Circle, add members with add_circle_member (or seed them here), then invite_circle_member to mint the enrollment deep link each contact taps to bind their messenger identity.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

telegram_chat_id.description: Telegram chat id (declared; usually captured at enrollment instead)

whatsapp_phone.description: E.164 WhatsApp phone with a leading + (declared)

profile_id.description: Public profile (sub-account) to bind for branded messages — create-only

proof_me_enabled.description: Enable Proof-Me drills for this Circle

name: create_circle
